$comment: Completion bar for #137: save an answer/moment as a note (provenance + AI-draft until confirmed). Per ADR 0002, the AI-draft flag is a status value ('ai-draft'), provenance is a body header (source_url / t_start / t_end / cited), and unconfirmed drafts never outrank confirmed notes/sources in retrieval. Adds 'Save as note' on Ask + Media-chat assistant messages and 'Save this moment' in Media chat (opens the note editor pre-filled, project from the current scope), an 'AI draft' badge + 'Confirm draft' action in the note editor, and editing a saved draft confirms it (saves as active). searchQuery demotes ai-draft notes.

criteria.target: grep -q "ai-draft" electron/search.ts && grep -q "openPrefilledDraft" src/hooks/useNotes.ts && grep -q "Save as note" src/features/ChatView.tsx && grep -q "Save this moment" src/plugins/media-chat/MediaChatView.tsx && grep -q "AI draft" src/features/NotePeek.tsx
